Code a 3D plane game in the browser
A Hugging Face product head prompted Manus to build a Three.js plane-control game and got an animated 3D browser game.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Victor Mustar, head of product at Hugging Face, got access to Manus and prompted it to create an animated 3D video game that runs in a web browser, using the Three.js library. The article gives no further detail on the prompt, the steps Manus took, or any manual edits.
How it went
Mustar called Manus the most impressive AI tool he had tried. The article gives no technical results, game details, or limitations for this test.
Worth knowing
The source is a short news piece about Manus reviews. It doesn't give the prompt, timing or cost, so you'd need Mustar's original X post for specifics.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Build a browser-based 3D game with Three.js where the player controls a [vehicle, e.g. plane] using [keys, e.g. arrow keys or WASD] through [scene, e.g. a landscape with obstacles]. Include smooth animation, a score, and a restart button. Finish when it runs in the browser preview and tell me the controls.
Original source: https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-trends/article/3301969/less-structure-more-intelligence-ai-agent-manus-draws-upbeat-reviews-nascent-system
